Matched and nested case-control sampling

Source: R/lang_v2.R
omop_match.Rd

A bounded, private, server-side risk-set sampler: for every case episode (case time = the case's index date) eligible controls are the persons satisfying the controls criteria population evaluated at the case time, alive, at risk (no outcome on or before the case time under prior_outcome = "exclude"), in the same strata; controls are taken in a seeded hash order. The result population has the episodes (person, index = case time) with set_id, is_case and sampling_weight (omop_population_column).

Usage

omop_match(
  cases,
  controls,
  outcome,
  at = "index",
  match = list(),
  controls_per_case = 4L,
  prior_outcome = c("exclude", "allow"),
  future_cases = c("eligible", "ineligible"),
  replacement = c("between_sets", "none"),
  seed = 1L,
  insufficient = c("keep_available", "drop_case"),
  missing_strata = c("ineligible", "match_missing"),
  max_candidates = 1e+06
)

omop_age_band(width = 5L)

omop_strata(event, before = NULL, window = NULL)

Arguments

cases

Population id (or object) whose episodes are cases.

controls

Criteria population id (or object) used as a template.

outcome

Event giving the complete outcome history.

at

"index".

match

List of "sex", "calendar_year", omop_age_band() and omop_strata() items.

controls_per_case

Controls per case.

prior_outcome, future_cases, replacement, insufficient, missing_strata

Sampling policies (see the design).

seed

Non-negative integer seed.

max_candidates

Cap on the candidate pairs (exceeding it is a typed refusal, never a truncation).

width

Age band width (years) at case time.

event

An event (strata presence before case time).

before

Strata: presence in the before days up to case time.

window

Strata: an explicit window around case time.

Value

omop_match, or a match item for match.
